messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: automatic paging triggered for service=runtime-inference, region=us-west-2. Metric: p99_latency (1m) = 1640ms (> SLO=1200ms). Suggested action: runbook/latency-tail -> triage. PagerDuty incident opened: PD-43218.

pagerduty: PD-43218 fired and routed to #eng-oncall. Escalation policy: oncall -> primary-runtime -> infra.

alex (oncall): acked PD-43218 :thumbsup: I'm on it. Starting quick triage — will collect flame graphs and top hotpaths.

april (automated-monitor): noise suppression check: multiple related alerts from p95 and p99 in same window; source clusters: rw-infer-usw2-a,b,c.

omar (runtime): noticing larger-than-usual KV cache evictions in logs for model=redwood-13b-q4h_legacy. Likely cache thrash. Can we check request key distribution?

alex (oncall): running `kubectl -n inference logs svc/runtime-proxy --since=5m | grep p99` to gather logs, and querying metrics: `prometheus_query("histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(latency_bucket[1m])) by (le,instance))")`

priya (infra): I'm increasing the autoscaler floor for the us-west pool by +2 nodes to buy time. Command: `infractl scalepool --pool inference-usw2 --min 6 --now`. ETA ~40s for new nodes to join.

sasha-support: any known customer impact? Support telemetry shows increased latency spikes on a handful of high-throughput customers in us-west but no widespread 5xx. Customers A and B reported slow responses ~30s ago.

omar (runtime): On the routing side, I can flip a canary to route 15% of traffic to model-13b-quantized-v2 which has smaller KV working set. Would like ops approval.

alex (oncall): do it. Patch: `routerctl set-weight inference-service model-13b-quantized-v2 0.15 --region=us-west-2`

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for model-13b-quantized-v2 @ 15% in us-west-2.

(priory note) priya (infra): nodes are initialising, autoscaler health checks passing. New pods scheduled onto new nodes.

omar (runtime): early telemetry from canary: p99 down from 1640ms -> 980ms for canary shard. Good sign. KV evictions on canary are lower.

alex (oncall): good. Adding temporary request-level throttling for large-ticket customers to keep tail under control: `runtimectl set-rate-limit --route /v1/generate --rl 20rps --customer A,B`

sasha-support: I've DM'ed both customers with ETA on mitigation and asked for sampling of slow traces. They acknowledged.

incident-bot: Update: PD-43218 status changed: acknowledged by alex (oncall). Next escalation (if unacked in 10m): primary-runtime.

omar (runtime): quick check: observed a correlated spike in background batching CPU usage right before tail jump — looks like a background KV sweep job kicked off and contended with hot shards.

alex (oncall): can we pause the sweep job? Which service?

omar (runtime): `kv-maintainer` on nodes in pool inference-usw2-b. I propose pausing the job for 15m across the region: `psched pause job kv-maintainer --region=us-west-2 --duration=15m`. This should reduce contention.

priya (infra): pause issued via ops orchestrator. Confirmed pausing 3/3 jobs; will resume automatically.

omar (runtime): after pausing, p99 for canary and the rest started trending down. Global p99 now ~1200ms (from 1640ms). KV eviction rate decreased by ~60%.

alex (oncall): customer-impact note for the incident record: initial impact window (1768456700 - 1768456900). Affected requests ~2.1% of global qps, mostly high-concurrency customers. No increased 5xx seen, just latency.

eve-se: adding a note: feature flags for model fallback are in place; recommend keeping canary routing at 15% for 30m and monitor. Also propose adding an automated suppression rule to avoid autopager for identical metric groups if mitigation in-flight.

incident-bot: PD-43218 updated: mitigation in progress (canary routing + autoscale + kv-maintainer pause). PagerDuty: next check-in in 10m.

alex (oncall): preparing handoff — my shift ends in 22m. Priya / Omar, can you take second-level ownership if anything flares while I'm out? I'll leave runbook checklist in the thread.

priya (infra): happy to take rotation backup. I'll monitor nodes and autoscaler.

omar (runtime): I'll own runtime mitigations and rollback if tail resurges.

sasha-support: support will keep customers updated and collect slow traces.

alex (oncall): runbook checklist pasted below:

```
1) Confirm PD incident and ack
2) Identify affected region/pool
3) Check KV eviction rates and batching CPU
4) Consider quick autoscale increase
5) Route small % to quantized/fallback model
6) Pause non-critical batch jobs (kv-maintainer / background-sweeps)
7) Apply temporary customer throttles for extreme tails
8) Monitor p95/p99 and customer reports for 30m before close
```

incident-bot: Note: PD-43218 will auto-escalate if p99 exceeds 1400ms for >5m after mitigation window.

(pagerduty): PD-43218 acknowledged by alex (oncall) at 1768456789. Currently not escalated.

alex (oncall): handing off to priya and omar in 20m. Leaving notes and links to dashboards: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/latency/rt-infer-usw2 and traces: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/trace?service=runtime-inference

priya (infra): thanks — oncall handover accepted. Will post periodic check-ins every 10m.

omar (runtime): adding final note: we should consider tuning kv-maintainer window and lower concurrency on background tasks during peak traffic going forward. Filing a follow-up ticket: INF-7834.

alex (oncall): thanks all — I'm out in 18m. Current state: degradation improved, canary successful so far, autoscale in progress, background job paused. Will update incident record with timeline.

incident-bot: PD-43218 next check-in scheduled at 1768456839 (10m). Last message in thread at 1768456945.
